tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Every city LocalSpot Trip plans (Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Europe, Turkey, UAE, Egypt, Canada, USA, Mexico, Peru, Argentina, Brazil, Australia), with the trip lengths it has ready-made plans for. Optional country filter (e.g. japan, france, usa).

tools.name: trip_plan
tools.description: A ready day-by-day plan for a city: neighbourhoods per day, timed sights and meals (places locals eat), travel minutes, plus links to open and edit it in the planner, compare where to stay, and see where locals eat. Give the traveller the open_in_planner link.

tools.name: request_city
tools.description: Ask LocalSpot Trip to add a city it does not plan yet (when list_destinations does not have it). Counts the request; the most requested cities are built first. Tell the traveller it is not covered yet and that the request was passed on. No personal data.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Korean cities and their neighbourhoods covered by local.korea.

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Restaurants, cafés or bars in a Korean city, best first by local card payments. Optional: neighbourhood, food keyword, open at a given day and time. Up to 8 results.

tools.name: place_info
tools.description: Hours, break time, closing days, rush hour, why it is picked, and links for one place by name (Korean or English).

tools.name: open_nearby
tools.description: Closed or a long line? Places open at a given time within a short walk (about 900 m) of a place or a point.

tools.name: sights
tools.description: Sights in a Korean city (optionally one neighbourhood): best time of day, typical visit minutes, closing day, a practical tip.

tools.name: plan_link
tools.description: A link that opens the local.korea planner with these places and sights loaded, split into days by neighbourhood with hours checked. Give it to the traveller.
